<translate>
'''Capsules''' are consumables that '''permanently raise one of your attributes''' when used. The '''color''' of the capsule decides which stat it raises (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]]). The '''Mastery Capsule''' instead adds mastery to your active transformation.
</translate>

<translate>
== How capsules work ==

* A normal capsule grants '''+5''' to its stat. Server owners can change the amount and the stat of each capsule.
* A stat that is already at its cap isn't raised, and the capsule isn't used up.
* You need a created character to use any capsule.
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|capsules}}

== Stat capsules ==

All stat capsules are shapeless recipes made with a Curative Flask, an Empty Capsule and the matching plants from [[Special:MyLanguage/Farming|Farming]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Empty Capsule ==

Craft it with a Glass Pane over Redstone over an Iron Ingot, in one vertical column.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gete Capsules ==

'''Gete Capsules''' are the rare Gete-tech versions of each color. They raise the same stat but grant '''×3''' the points ('''+15''').

* Craft one from a capsule of that color and a Gete Ingot (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Tech]]).
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] world boss drops each of the six Gete Capsules with a 12% chance.
* Bulma's '''Capsule Tech''' sidequest rewards a Red and an Orange Gete Capsule.
</translate>

<translate>
== Mastery Capsule ==

Shapeless recipe: Curative Flask + Amethyst Shard + Empty Capsule + 2 Zenkai Lotus.

Use it while transformed to gain '''+5 mastery''' in your active form. It does nothing in base form or when the form's mastery is already maxed out. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations|Transformations]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Other sources and uses ==

* The quest '''The Sacred Water''' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 19) rewards a Red, a Green and a Blue Capsule along with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Water|Sacred Water]].
* A Green, Blue or Yellow Capsule crafted with a Namek Moss gives Senzu Bean Seeds (Health, Ki or Stamina). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bean|Senzu Bean]].
</translate>
